trainer_scp.name: Pokémon Ace Trainer (Male)
trainer_scp.containment_advisories: SCP-T061 must not be allowed near high-threat SCPs without supervision. Personnel must avoid engaging SCP-T061 in combat drills without authorization.
trainer_scp.description: SCP-T061 displays elite-level combat adaptability, capable of coordinating with multiple SCP types simultaneously. Frequently participates in mixed-type containment simulations.
addendum_logs: Addendum T061-A: SCP-T061 neutralized SCP-0054 (Psyduck)’s psychic burst using improvised tactics.
Addendum T061-B: SCP-T061 resisted SCP-0077 (Ponyta)’s flame output with minimal injury.

trainer_scp.name: Pokémon Ace Trainer (Female)
trainer_scp.containment_advisories: SCP-T062 must not be allowed near SCP-0142 (Aerodactyl) or SCP-0146 (Moltres).
trainer_scp.description: SCP-T062 displays exceptional combat prediction and multi-type coordination. Frequently used in containment drills involving unpredictable SCP entities.
addendum_logs: Addendum T062-A: SCP-T062 predicted SCP-0068 (Machamp)’s attack pattern with 92% accuracy.
Addendum T062-B: SCP-T062 resisted SCP-0087 (Dewgong)’s freezing mist with minimal impairment.

trainer_scp.name: Pokémon Tamer
trainer_scp.containment_advisories: SCP-T063 must not be allowed near SCP-0128 (Tauros) or SCP-0149 (Dragonite). Personnel must maintain a minimum distance of 10 meters during demonstrations.
trainer_scp.description: SCP-T063 displays anomalous influence over aggressive SCP entities, capable of suppressing rage states through physical presence and vocal command.
addendum_logs: Addendum T063-A: SCP-T063 suppressed SCP-0077 (Ponyta)’s flame surge with a single command.
Addendum T063-B: SCP-T063 resisted SCP-0034 (Nidoking)’s charge with minor injuries.

trainer_scp.name: Pokémon Juggler
trainer_scp.containment_advisories: Personnel must avoid exposing SCP-T064 to volatile SCPs such as SCP-0100 (Voltorb).
trainer_scp.description: SCP-T064 displays anomalous kinetic manipulation, capable of redirecting small projectiles and maintaining control over multiple moving objects simultaneously.
addendum_logs: Addendum T064-A: SCP-T064 redirected SCP-0025 (Pikachu)’s electric projectile mid-air.
Addendum T064-B: SCP-T064 juggled six containment spheres without error.

trainer_scp.name: Pokémon Rocker
trainer_scp.containment_advisories: Personnel must wear auditory protection during interaction. SCP-T065 must not be allowed near SCP-0121 (Starmie) or SCP-0094 (Gengar).
trainer_scp.description: SCP-T065 displays anomalous sonic projection capable of disrupting containment sensors and destabilizing spectral SCP entities.
addendum_logs: Addendum T065-A: SCP-T065’s sonic output disrupted three containment monitors.
Addendum T065-B: SCP-0121’s gem pulse destabilized in SCP-T065’s presence.

trainer_scp.name: Pokémon Gentleman (Cruise Ship Variant)
trainer_scp.containment_advisories: Personnel must avoid allowing SCP-T066 to negotiate with SCP entities without supervision.
trainer_scp.description: SCP-T066 displays anomalous persuasive ability, capable of influencing docile SCP entities and calming low-threat anomalies.
addendum_logs: Addendum T066-A: SCP-T066 convinced SCP-0058 (Growlithe) to release a guard unharmed.
Addendum T066-B: SCP-0077 (Ponyta) displayed reduced flame output in SCP-T066’s presence.

trainer_scp.name: Pokémon Sailor (Cruise Ship Variant)
trainer_scp.containment_advisories: SCP-T067 may assist in maritime SCP containment. Personnel must avoid exposing SCP-T067 to SCP-0130 (Gyarados).
trainer_scp.description: SCP-T067 displays anomalous resilience to maritime hazards and can operate safely in unstable aquatic environments.
addendum_logs: Addendum T067-A: SCP-T067 stabilized a containment raft during SCP-0116’s agitation.
Addendum T067-B: SCP-T067 resisted SCP-0117 (Seadra)’s hydrokinesis blast.

trainer_scp.name: Pokémon Firebreather
trainer_scp.containment_advisories: Personnel must maintain fire suppression systems during SCP-T068 demonstrations. SCP-T068 must not be allowed near SCP-0146 (Moltres).
trainer_scp.description: SCP-T068 displays limited pyrokinesis and flame projection capabilities. Frequently performs controlled fire displays that can destabilize nearby fire-type SCP entities.
addendum_logs: Addendum T068-A: SCP-T068 ignited containment padding during a demonstration.
Addendum T068-B: SCP-T068 resisted SCP-0126 (Magmar)’s heat output with minimal injury.

trainer_scp.name: Pokémon Medium (High-Level)
trainer_scp.containment_advisories: Personnel must maintain spectral shielding. SCP-T069 must not be exposed to SCP-0094 (Gengar).
trainer_scp.description: SCP-T069 displays advanced spectral communication and projection capabilities, capable of interacting with mid-level ghost-type SCP entities.
addendum_logs: Addendum T069-A: SCP-T069 communicated with SCP-0093 (Haunter) during a containment breach.
Addendum T069-B: SCP-T069’s spectral projection disrupted containment sensors.

trainer_scp.name: Pokémon Dragon Tamer
trainer_scp.containment_advisories: SCP-T070 must not be allowed near SCP-0149 (Dragonite) during agitation cycles. Personnel must avoid aerial zones during SCP-T070’s training.
trainer_scp.description: SCP-T070 displays anomalous resilience and limited atmospheric manipulation, likely influenced by prolonged exposure to draconic SCP entities.
addendum_logs: Addendum T070-A: SCP-T070 redirected SCP-0148 (Dragonair)’s electrical discharge.
Addendum T070-B: SCP-T070 survived SCP-0149’s tail strike with moderate injuries.
